The '''Emperor's Hand''' was a quadrant of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]]. Access to the quadrant was dangerous due to the presence of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
